conflict_resolutions.EMPTY_CATALOG_NOTE_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH_CU: The empty catalog note establishes nothing about effect or ending.

material_gaps: No acceptable official original: the only held text is an American Presidency Project transcription (not an official edition, never acceptable_as_original).

No held ACT:, TERM: or ACTOR_TEXT: record and no CURRENT: predicate; a one-person appointment authorization has no acting instrument to find, and its status turns on whether the authority was spent on use, which no held source shows.
notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: BLOCKED. I read the complete held text of EO 7737 (Nov. 6, 1937), which is only the American Presidency Project transcription: under the Civil Service Act, Mrs. Mary G. Bird 'may be appointed' to a classified position in the Farm Credit Administration without compliance with Civil Service Rules, because she would have become eligible for civil-service status under EO 6758 had she not been appointed to an excepted position on June 1, 1934; recommended by the Governor of the FCA. It states no duration, condition or savings language. The history has only an empty catalog note and no printed citation (the catalog gives no FR citation). Identity cannot be confirmed from an official edition and the only text is an unofficial copy. Leaning, not asserted: a one-time individual appointment authority, likely spent once she was appointed, so a NO is plausible, but that is an inference and not a held ending. Needs: the official Federal Register original, then any record that the appointment was made or the authority lapsed.
